decisions.reason: Disabling Thrive Apprentice as an interim plugin-security measure does not change the existing malware-artifact cleanup approach or its state.
The Thrive Apprentice decision does not alter which unauthorized accounts must be removed or which authorized accounts must be retained.
Disabling Thrive Apprentice does not change the rule for deleting malware-generated content.
The interim plugin disablement does not change the credential-rotation targets or completed password updates.
The source decision does not alter the indexed spam URLs or the Search Console removal method.
Disabling Thrive Apprentice does not modify the approved follow-up scans, recurrence monitoring, or monitoring window.

Thrive Apprentice is identified as the learning-platform plugin, while this candidate concerns retaining the current Thrive page builder and migrating pages to Elementor. The separate uncertainty about postponing full page-builder removal is already represented by the candidate's same-message AMBIGUOUS Event.
The interim disablement of Thrive Apprentice does not change the Wordfence scanner, its scan targets, or its automated protection behavior.
The source does not establish any change to the legacy site's page-speed goal or performance state.
The interim Thrive Apprentice security action does not change the requested performance findings or before-and-after report.
The Thrive Apprentice decision is unrelated to whether site comments remain disabled.
The interim plugin-security action does not change the deferred HLX page-speed requirement or its cache-related performance issue.
